name: agent-journal
description: A .NET-based MCP server for indexing, searching, and managing AI agent conversation sessions

AGENT_JOURNAL_DATA_PATH.description: Custom path for storing databases and indexes (default: ~/.agent-journal)

AGENT_JOURNAL_DECAY_HALFLIFE_DAYS.description: Half-life in days for knowledge decay (default: 90)

AGENT_JOURNAL_DEFAULT_SEARCH_MODE.description: Default search mode: lexical, semantic, or hybrid (default: hybrid)
